# Text Block

`content/text-block` &middot; section-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A heading and body copy in a full-width section, with an optional button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | richtext |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Left-aligned heading and copy.
- **centered**: Centered heading, copy and button. Sets `align: center`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingTight @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paragraph margins can differ slightly. | Fine. | Text and background swap via dm-* classes where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/text-block', {
  "heading": "Made for slower mornings",
  "body": "<p>Our summer collection is cut from breathable linen and washed cotton, designed to move with you from the first coffee to the last light.</p>",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Explore the collection",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/text-block",
  "data": {
    "heading": "Made for slower mornings",
    "body": "<p>Our summer collection is cut from breathable linen and washed cotton, designed to move with you from the first coffee to the last light.</p>",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Explore the collection",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/summer"
    }
  }
}
```
